price_by_size: Official help center (help.fundednext.com/en/articles/17253243, checked 2026-11-23): $2K $59.99, $5K $149.99, $10K $299.99, $20K $599.99 (one-time, non-refundable; max total active allocation $20K; no 25K size). Only the $5K ($149.99) is inside the $100-150 band. Reset costs 10% less than purchase price. Add-ons (EA, VPS & EA, Swap-Free) are extra; Swap-Free add-on price not listed officially (a third-party review reports ~10% more, e.g. 20K $659 vs $599) [uncertain]. Published coupon not used.
turkey_accepted: Official CFD restricted-country article (help.fundednext.com/en/articles/8020080) text lists: Bangladesh, Myanmar, Belarus, North Korea, Syria, Grenada, Chad, Malaysia, Belize, Antigua and Barbuda, Cape Verde, Tuvalu, Vietnam, Bouvet Island, Burundi, Cook Islands, Eritrea, Comoros, Sri Lanka, Fiji. Turkey is not in the text, but the article also refers to a country list shown as an image that could not be read [uncertain]. Turkey appears on the separate FundedNext Futures restricted list (not the CFD/Stellar Instant product). fundednext.com/tr (Turkish site) exists.
turkey_payout_kyc: Payout methods per official article: USDT (ERC20/TRC20), USDC (ERC20), Confirmo, RiseWorks, bank transfer, FNmarkets deposit, card payout (Iran limited to TC Pay). Turkey-specific KYC/payout behaviour not stated [uncertain].
platform: Official Stellar Instant pages do not state platforms. Third-party sources: MT4/MT5 for CFDs (Match-Trader for US clients) [uncertain]. Official EA article states EAs/bots allowed on MT4 and MT5 only; Match-Trader and cTrader do not support automated trading.
ea_clause_text: Official (help.fundednext.com/en/articles/11641338): "Yes, traders are allowed to use Expert Advisors (EAs) and Trading Bots in the Stellar Instant Account." Requires paid EA add-on (or VPS & EA add-on), EAs allowed in 5K-25K accounts, MT4/MT5 only; "Each EA or bot must use a distinct strategy"; must customize settings; EAs using Telegram/WhatsApp prohibited; named commercial EAs banned. Forbidden list (fundednext.com/general-rules/cfds/what-is-forbidden): using VPS/EA without add-on approval, high-frequency trading bots/mass order placement, tick scalping (trades held a few seconds), grid trading without risk logic, copy trading from accounts not owned by you, cross-account hedging. VPN/VPS permitted.
overnight_weekend: Official Stellar Instant article: weekend holding "Allowed with no restrictions. Swap charges apply." Overnight not separately addressed but implied allowed. BTC-specific weekend rule not stated [uncertain].
swap_free_scope: Swap charges apply by default. A paid Swap-Free Add-On at checkout removes overnight swap charges (price not listed officially; cannot be added later per third-party review) [uncertain]. Whether the add-on covers crypto/BTC is not stated officially [uncertain]. Not swap-free without the add-on.
us100_btc: Official pages list categories only (Forex, Indices, Commodities, Crypto, Stocks); US100/NAS100 and BTCUSD not named on the fetched official pages [uncertain]. Leverage on stellar-instant page: Forex 1:30, Indices 1:10, Commodities 1:10, Crypto 1:1 (third-party says 1:1 or 1:2), Stocks 1:2. Third-party: ~9 crypto pairs. No lot cap stated (no restrictions on lot size or trade frequency).
drawdown: Official: no daily loss limit; Maximum Loss Limit 6% trailing from initial balance (moves up with profit, stops at starting balance, does not decrease with losses; carries over after withdrawal). Risk per trade must stay at or below 3% at any time.
consistency_min_days: Official: no consistency rule, no minimum trading days, no profit target. 60-day inactivity rule applies.
first_payout: Official: on-demand reward when account has 5% growth (checked at end of day); otherwise with 1%-5% growth a 14-day cycle; below 1% growth no reward and cycle extends. Reward share 70% (Tier 1-2), 80% from Tier 3, scalable up to 90% (95% upgrade option). No explicit minimum amount found [uncertain].
news_gambling: News trading allowed with no timing restriction, but profits from trades within 5 minutes before/after high-impact news on correlated pairs count at 40%; losses count fully. Gambling-style behaviour and one-sided betting with no exit strategy are listed as forbidden. Hedging allowed inside a single account only.

fits_all_hard: BELIRSIZ. Met by official source: MT5 EA allowed (paid add-on), weekend holding allowed, 5K $149.99 in range, instant (no challenge). Not confirmed: Turkey vs CFD country image, BTC swap-free (only paid add-on, crypto coverage unstated), US100/BTCUSD symbol availability (categories only).
